blocks.html: The said du Tilh, heard once again, persevered in what is above, as many as three and four times; nay, even being on the ladder of the gibbet, before the house of the said Martin Guerre, where the execution was carried out, he confessed frankly to having built and carried out the said imposture, in the form above: asking pardon of the said Martin Guerre and Bertrande de Rols, married persons, and of the said Pierre Guerre, uncle of the said Martin, with great signs of repentance and detestation of his deed, crying all the while upon God for mercy, through His Son Jesus Christ. And thus he was executed, his body hanged, and afterwards burnt.

notes.citation: Digest 34.1 (De alimentis vel cibariis legatis), l. 3 (D. 34.1.3)
notes.original: l. iij. D. de alimen. & cibar. lega.
notes.gloss: Fragment content not verified; the attachment to the dative executors is an inference from the margin position and is not certain.
